s: A core differentiator of our AI Agents is their ability to operate within well-defined boundaries, producing accurate, contextually appropriate responses while minimizing the risk of fabricated or misleading outputs, commonly referred to as “hallucinations.” This is achieved through a combination of architectural design choices, configurable safety layers, and ongoing validation practices.
next: Our platform is built on retrieval-augmented generation (“RAG”), a technique in which the AI system retrieves relevant information from an approved, client-specific knowledge base before generating a response. s: The Company’s platform ingests video, sensor and event data generated at the edge by surveillance cameras and other sensors, as well as by the video management, access control and other physical security systems its customers have already deployed; structures that data using AI models; and makes the resulting structured data available to users for real-time alerting, historical search and, increasingly, natural-language query and agentic AI workflows.
next: The Company serves government and law enforcement agencies, principally U.S. federal homeland security and law enforcement customers, as well as large commercial organizations with similar sensor, security and data-management requirements. name: Airship AI Holdings, Inc.  (AISP, AISPW)  (CIK 0001842566)
s: The Company’s software platform consists of Outpost AI (edge software for structuring and analyzing sensor data at the point of collection), Acropolis (the enterprise management software backbone, deployable on-premises or in cloud and multi-cloud architectures), Airship Command (visualization and operator tools across workstation, web and mobile) and Ask Airship (an agentic AI layer, currently under development, designed to allow users to query, analyze and act on structured data using natural language).
next: The platform is designed to operate as an open software layer above a customer’s existing video management, access control and other physical security systems, independent of the underlying camera or hardware vendor, so that customers can add analytical and agentic capability to infrastructure they have already deployed.
